evidence.claim: Nebius reported Q2 revenue of USD 582.3 million, up 454% year over year, adjusted EBITDA of USD 236.2 million and GAAP continuing-operations net loss of USD 190.4 million. Purchases of property, equipment and intangible assets were USD 5.6574 billion, while operating cash flow included USD 4.2563 billion of customer advances and prepayments.
